svg.title: New input that arrives during generation
svg.desc: Top: a chat or agent message that arrives at step 3 becomes a new request R2. Request R1 keeps generating, both run in the same steps, and R2 reuses the full blocks of R1 through the prefix cache. Bottom: in a streaming input session, chunk 2 arrives at step 2 and waits in streaming_queue. When turn 1 stops after step 3, chunk 2 continues the same request from step 4, and the KV blocks are kept for the whole session.

g.text: NEW CHAT OR AGENT MESSAGE · A NEW REQUEST
THE OLD REQUEST KEEPS GENERATING · BOTH SHARE THE STEP AND THE FULL BLOCKS
R2 REUSES THE FULL BLOCKS OF R1 BY PREFIX CACHE (REF_CNT 2)
STREAMING INPUT SESSION · THE SAME REQUEST ID
THE NEXT CHUNK WAITS IN STREAMING_QUEUE UNTIL THE CURRENT TURN STOPS
same KV blocks · never freed between chunks
